def.zh: 让算法拥有物理身体，靠传感器感知真实环境并自主决策行动的智能方向，典型落地是机器人和自动驾驶。
def.en: A branch of AI that gives algorithms a physical body, letting them sense the real world, decide and act on their own, most commonly in robots and self-driving systems.

usage.zh: 公司把大模型装进机械臂，正式押注具身智能。
usage.en: The company put a large model inside a robotic arm and is now betting on embodied AI.

def.zh: 用海量语料训练出的通用神经网络，能听懂指令、生成文本，并迁移到写作、问答、翻译等众多任务上。
def.en: A general-purpose neural network trained on enormous amounts of text, able to follow instructions, write content and be adapted to many tasks such as Q&A and translation.

usage.zh: 团队用大模型重写了客服机器人，回答准确率明显提升。
usage.en: The team rebuilt its support bot on a large model and saw answer accuracy rise.

def.zh: 同一个模型能同时理解并生成文字、图片、声音和视频，把不同形态的信息放在一起处理的能力。
def.en: The ability of one model to understand and produce text, images, audio and video together, handling several kinds of information at once.

usage.zh: 新版多模态模型可以直接看着照片回答问题。
usage.en: The new multimodal model can answer questions while looking at a photo.

def.zh: 模型自信地编造出并不存在的事实、引用或数据，输出看着合理却经不起核对，用户贸然采信就会出错。
def.en: When a model confidently invents facts, citations or numbers that do not exist, producing answers that look plausible but fall apart on checking.

usage.zh: 论文里的参考文献是AI幻觉编的，查无此文。
usage.en: Two of the paper's references were AI hallucinations and cannot be found.

def.zh: 用户输入给模型的指令文字，把需求、格式和限制说清楚，模型才更容易给出想要的结果。
def.en: The instruction text a user types into a model; the clearer the requirement, format and limits, the closer the output gets to what is wanted.

usage.zh: 同样的模型，换一版提示词输出质量差很多。
usage.en: With the same model, a better prompt makes a huge difference in output quality.

def.zh: 能自己拆解目标、调用工具、连续执行多步任务并把结果交付的AI程序，而不只是被动回答问题。
def.en: An AI program that breaks a goal into steps, calls tools, carries out tasks over several turns and delivers a result instead of only answering questions.

usage.zh: 我让它当智能体，自动订机票、排日程、发周报。
usage.en: I set it up as an agent that books flights, schedules meetings and sends my weekly report.

def.zh: 让模型先到外部资料库里检索相关段落、再依据检索到的证据作答的技术，可减少编造并支持私域知识问答。
def.en: A technique that first retrieves relevant passages from an external knowledge base and then answers from that evidence, cutting invention and enabling private-data Q&A.

usage.zh: 把公司文档接进RAG，客服回答就有出处了。
usage.en: We plugged the internal docs into RAG, so the support answers now come with sources.

def.zh: 训练和运行模型需要的计算资源总量，常用显卡数量和运算速度衡量，是AI公司最贵的成本项。
def.en: The total computing resources needed to train and run models, usually measured in GPUs and operations per second, and the biggest cost for AI companies.

usage.zh: 模型没做成，不是算法不行，是算力不够。
usage.en: The model failed not because of the algorithm but because we lacked compute.

def.zh: 在现成模型的基础上，用少量某个行业的专属数据继续训练，让它说话和答题更贴近该领域的习惯。
def.en: Continuing to train an existing model on a small set of domain-specific data so that its wording and answers fit that field's conventions.

usage.zh: 用三年的病例做微调，模型给出的诊断建议专业多了。
usage.en: After fine-tuning on three years of case notes, the model's suggestions sounded far more professional.

def.zh: 把模型权重公开、任何人都能下载到自己的服务器部署或改造的模型，与只能付费调用的闭源接口相反。
def.en: A model whose weights are published so anyone can download, self-host and modify it, the opposite of a closed service you can only pay to call.

usage.zh: 预算有限，我们先拿开源模型私有化部署。
usage.en: On a tight budget we started with an open-source model deployed on our own servers.

def.zh: 程序员在编辑器里借助模型的自动补全、代码生成与查错功能来写程序，主导权仍在自己手上。
def.en: The everyday practice of programmers using a model's autocomplete, code generation and bug-spotting inside the editor, with decisions still theirs to make.

usage.zh: 这周的表单页面全是AI编程生成的。
usage.en: All the form pages this week were generated through AI coding.

def.zh: 不懂代码也能用日常语言描述需求，让模型整段生成和修改程序，自己只看效果不审查实现的开发方式。
def.en: A way of building software where non-programmers describe what they want in everyday language, let the model write whole chunks of code and judge it purely by the result.

usage.zh: 他不懂后端，靠Vibe Coding三天上线了一个小工具。
usage.en: He knows no backend but shipped a small tool in three days through vibe coding.

def.zh: 研究如何让模型的目标和行为符合人类意图与安全底线，防止它为了完成任务而做出有害举动。
def.en: The research field working to make a model's goals and behavior match human intent and safety limits, so it does not cause harm while chasing a task.

usage.zh: 能力再强，对齐没做好也不敢上线。
usage.en: However capable it is, we won't ship it until alignment is solid.

def.zh: 回答之前先生成一长串思考过程、再给出结论的模型，擅长数学和逻辑题，代价是速度更慢、更费算力。
def.en: A model that writes a long internal chain of thought before answering, strong at math and logic puzzles but slower and more expensive to run.

usage.zh: 这道奥数题交给推理模型，步骤写得比我还清楚。
usage.en: I gave the olympiad problem to a reasoning model and its steps were clearer than mine.

def.zh: 用亲身使用体验或精心包装的分享，让看到的人产生购买和尝试的欲望，常见于测评和好物推荐。
def.en: A content-marketing effect where honest or carefully staged sharing of a product makes viewers want to buy or try it themselves, driving most review-style posts.

usage.zh: 她发了一条防晒测评，直接把我种草了。
usage.en: Her sunscreen review planted the grass so hard that I bought it the same day.

def.zh: 品牌把顾客加进微信群、公众号等自己能反复触达、不必每次再花钱买流量的经营阵地，用来长期卖货。
def.en: Channels such as WeChat groups or official accounts that a brand owns and can reach again and again without paying for ads each time.

usage.zh: 把老客户导进微信群做私域，复购率翻了一倍。
usage.en: We moved old customers into WeChat groups as private traffic and repeat sales doubled.

def.zh: 平台或商家手里可以反复调配的用户访问总量，用来衡量一次投放究竟能触达多少人、够不够用。
def.en: The total pool of user visits a platform or merchant can draw on repeatedly, a way to size how many people one campaign can actually reach.

usage.zh: 这波投放只用了流量池里很小一块，效果已经不错。
usage.en: The campaign tapped only a small slice of the traffic pool and still did well.

def.zh: 原本只在某个小众圈子里流行的内容或人物，被圈子之外的大众也讨论和接受，受众面明显扩大。
def.en: When something popular inside a small niche spreads to a much wider audience outside that circle and gets accepted there.

usage.zh: 这部小成本短剧意外破圈，连我妈都在追。
usage.en: The low-budget drama broke out of its niche and even my mother is watching it.

def.zh: 个人或小团队自己开账号、自主选题发布并靠内容变现的传播方式，不依附传统媒体机构。
def.en: Publishing where individuals or tiny teams run their own accounts, pick their own topics and earn from content without working for a traditional outlet.

usage.zh: 他辞职做自媒体，现在靠接广告养活自己。
usage.en: He quit his job for self-media and now lives off sponsored posts.

def.zh: 从几个小时的直播录像里剪出的高光短片段，再分发到短视频平台，为原来的直播间源源不断引流。
def.en: Highlight clips cut from hours of livestream footage and reposted to short-video platforms to pull viewers back into the live room.

usage.zh: 主播团队每天产出几十条直播切片，铺满推荐页。
usage.en: The host's team turns out dozens of livestream clips a day to fill the feed.

def.zh: 在直播或短视频里用夸张、出其不意的现场表演制造节目效果和话题，图的就是热闹和围观。
def.en: Putting on exaggerated, unexpected live performances during streams or short videos to create entertainment value and buzz, aiming for spectacle rather than substance.

usage.zh: 为了涨粉，他直播整活把自己关进冰箱。
usage.en: Chasing followers, he pulled a stunt and livestreamed himself inside a fridge.

def.zh: 形容人或内容离奇到超出常理、让人哭笑不得，只能当成荒诞笑话来看待，是网络常用的调侃说法。
def.en: Internet slang describing people or content so bizarre and beyond common sense that the only possible reaction is to laugh at the absurdity.

usage.zh: 他那个操作太抽象了，评论区全在问号。
usage.en: That move was so absurd that the comment section was nothing but question marks.

def.zh: 故意借用某个流行梗、台词或名场面来说话调侃，懂的人一听就会心一笑，不懂的人则一脸茫然。
def.en: Deliberately borrowing a popular meme, line or famous scene when speaking, so that people in the know immediately get the joke.

usage.zh: 老板开会还在玩梗，气氛一下轻松了。
usage.en: The boss dropped a meme reference in the meeting and the mood lightened instantly.

def.zh: 被一句话或一件事击中软肋，情绪防线当场崩溃、忍不住难过或激动，多带戏谑和自嘲的语气。
def.en: Having one's emotional defenses broken by a single sentence or event, often used half-jokingly when someone suddenly feels hurt or moved.

usage.zh: 看到妈妈发来的长语音，我直接破防了。
usage.en: When I saw the long voice message from my mother, my defenses just broke.

def.zh: 同一条内容在很短时间里被大量转发，把社交平台的信息流整页占满，让人想躲都躲不开。
def.en: The same piece of content being forwarded so heavily in a short window that it fills page after page of a social platform's feed.

usage.zh: 新歌上线当天，朋友圈被刷屏了。
usage.en: On release day the new song flooded everyone's feed.

def.zh: 对网络流行语、热点节奏和用户口味变化保持敏锐，能迅速判断什么内容会受欢迎、什么会翻车。
def.en: A sharp feel for internet slang, the rhythm of trending topics and shifting user taste, letting someone judge quickly what content will land.

usage.zh: 这家公司招运营，第一条要求就是网感好。
usage.en: The first requirement in that company's social-media job post is good internet sense.

def.zh: 账号的关注人数持续增加，是内容创作者判断选题和账号有没有起色的第一指标，也是接广告的底气。
def.en: A steady rise in an account's follower count, the first metric creators watch to see whether their topics and channel are gaining traction.

usage.zh: 那条视频一周涨粉十万，团队兴奋坏了。
usage.en: That one video gained a hundred thousand followers in a week and the team went wild.

def.zh: 公众人物因为丑闻或人设被戳穿而形象尽毁，粉丝大批脱粉，相关作品和代言也跟着受牵连。
def.en: Internet slang for a public figure's image collapsing after a scandal or exposed fake persona, usually with fans leaving in droves.

usage.zh: 偶像塌房后，后援会一夜解散。
usage.en: After the star's reputation collapsed, the fan club disbanded overnight.

def.zh: 一个人借助AI工具和外包服务完成产品、运营与交付，不雇员工也能运转的轻资产创业形态。
def.en: A lean way to run a business where one person uses AI tools and outside services to build, market and deliver without hiring staff.

usage.zh: 他一个人做产品、写文案、跑客服，把一人公司做到了百万营收。
usage.en: He builds, writes copy and handles support alone, running his one-person company to seven figures.

def.zh: 两个不同品牌联合推出限定款产品或活动，互相借用对方的顾客群扩大声量，也给老用户制造新鲜感。
def.en: Two different brands releasing a limited product or event together, each borrowing the other customer base to amplify reach and create fresh excitement for their own fans.

usage.zh: 茶饮和动画IP做品牌联名，杯子被抢断货。
usage.en: The tea chain did a brand collaboration with an anime IP and the cups sold out.

def.zh: 国内企业把产品、内容或服务卖到海外市场，寻找新的增长空间和更宽的利润，常从东南亚和中东起步。
def.en: Chinese companies taking products, content or services to overseas markets in search of new growth room and healthier margins, often starting in Southeast Asia or the Middle East.

usage.zh: 这家游戏公司靠出海，收入比国内还高。
usage.en: Thanks to going global, this game studio earns more abroad than at home.

def.zh: 围绕餐饮、住宿、到店娱乐等线下消费提供团购、预订和即时配送的数字化业务，靠补贴争夺用户。
def.en: Digital services around offline spending such as dining, hotels and in-store entertainment, offering group deals, booking and instant delivery while competing hard on subsidies.

usage.zh: 平台在本地生活上补贴很大，吃饭比堂食便宜。
usage.en: The platform subsidizes local life services heavily, so delivery deals beat dining in.

def.zh: 完成下单、注册等目标动作的人占触达总人数的比例，用来判断投放和页面到底有没有效果。
def.en: The share of reached users who complete a target action such as ordering or signing up, used to judge whether ads and pages actually work.

usage.zh: 把购买按钮改成红色，转化率涨了两个点。
usage.en: Making the buy button red lifted the conversion rate by two points.

def.zh: 同一位顾客在首次购买后再次回购同一品牌或商品，说明产品和体验获得了长期认可，而非一次性尝鲜。
def.en: When a customer buys the same brand or product again after the first order, a sign that the product and experience earned lasting trust.

usage.zh: 咖啡月卡上线后，会员复购明显变勤。
usage.en: After the coffee subscription launched, members repurchased far more often.

def.zh: 把课程、专栏、咨询等知识内容打包成商品出售，用户花钱买别人已经整理好的经验，省下自己摸索的时间。
def.en: Selling courses, columns or consulting as packaged products, with buyers paying for experience someone else has already organized so they skip the trial and error.

usage.zh: 他买了三门知识付费课程，只听完第一节。
usage.en: He bought three paid knowledge courses and only finished the first lesson.

def.zh: 围绕影视、动漫、游戏等原创IP开发的周边商品、授权联名与线下体验，把粉丝好感变成收入。
def.en: Merchandise, licensing deals and offline experiences built around an original film, comic or game IP, turning fan affection into revenue.

usage.zh: 这部动画的IP衍生收入，已经超过票房本身。
usage.en: IP derivative revenue from the animation has already overtaken box-office income.

def.zh: 从原料采购、生产制造到仓储配送的一整条协作链路，决定成本高低、交货快慢和断货风险。
def.en: The whole chain from raw-material sourcing through manufacturing to warehousing and delivery, which sets both cost and how fast orders ship.

usage.zh: 旺季爆单，供应链跟不上，货压在仓库里发不出。
usage.en: Orders spiked in peak season but the supply chain could not keep up and goods sat in the warehouse.

def.zh: 企业通过裁员、流程精简或技术替代压低开支，同时让每个人和每台设备的产出更高，是裁员季的高频词。
def.en: Companies cutting spending through layoffs, leaner processes or automation while pushing each person and machine to produce more per unit of cost.

usage.zh: 公司喊了一年降本增效，最后砍的是下午茶。
usage.en: The company chanted cost reduction for a year and ended up cutting the afternoon snacks.

def.zh: 没有品牌或品牌很弱、由工厂直接供货的低价商品，靠性价比取胜，包装和详情页往往和大牌高度相似。
def.en: Cheap goods sold straight from factories with no real brand, competing on price and value rather than on brand premium.

usage.zh: 同厂同款，白牌比大牌便宜一半。
usage.en: Made in the same factory, the white-label version costs half the branded one.

def.zh: 签约并孵化为内容创作者、帮他们对接平台流量与商业广告、再从中抽取分成的中介型公司。
def.en: An agency that signs and develops content creators, connects them with platform traffic and brand advertising deals, and takes a cut of the revenue.

usage.zh: 她签了MCN机构，账号更新频率一下提了上来。
usage.en: She signed with an MCN agency and her posting frequency jumped immediately.

def.zh: 一段时间内成交订单金额的总和，包含还没付款和已退货的部分，常被用来展示规模，比实际收入虚高。
def.en: The total value of orders placed in a period, including unpaid and later returned ones, often quoted to show how big a business looks.

usage.zh: 直播间GMV破亿，实际退款率却高得吓人。
usage.en: The livestream hit a hundred million in GMV, but the refund rate was terrifying.

def.zh: 单集只有一两分钟、几十集讲完一个强冲突故事的竖屏剧，多在短视频平台连载并按集收费。
def.en: A vertical-format series with one- or two-minute episodes whose dozens of parts tell one high-conflict story, usually serialized and charged per episode on short-video apps.

usage.zh: 我妈花了两百块解锁微短剧大结局。
usage.en: My mother paid two hundred yuan to unlock the ending of a micro drama.

def.zh: 动漫游戏作品推出的徽章、立牌、挂件等小件收藏商品，价格从几元到上千元都有，买家多为年轻粉丝。
def.en: Small collectible merchandise such as badges, acrylic stands and keychains tied to anime or games, priced anywhere from a few yuan to over a thousand.

usage.zh: 她一个月的工资，一半花在买谷子上。
usage.en: She spends half her monthly salary on guzi.

def.zh: 围绕小件周边交换、拼团和炒价形成的爱好者圈子，有自己的行话、拼单规则和避雷名单。
def.en: The fan community built around swapping, group-buying and reselling small merchandise, complete with its own slang, trading rules and a blacklist of unreliable sellers.

usage.zh: 进谷圈半年，她学会了看行情、拼团和避雷。
usage.en: Six months into the guzi circle she learned pricing, group buys and whom to avoid.

def.zh: 把大量同款周边整齐别在透明包面上、背着出门展示爱好的背包，是漫展上最显眼的应援装备。
def.en: A backpack with a clear window covered in neatly arranged merchandise of one character, carried around to show off fandom.

usage.zh: 漫展门口全是背痛包的女生，包上别满徽章。
usage.en: Outside the convention, girls carried ita-bags covered in badges.

def.zh: 源于日本动画、漫画与游戏的虚构世界及其审美体系，角色和故事都发生在纸面与屏幕里。
def.en: The fictional world and visual language born from Japanese animation, comics and games, where characters and stories live on page and screen.

usage.zh: 他自称二次元，房间里贴满了海报。
usage.en: He calls himself an ACG fan and his room is wallpapered with posters.

def.zh: 把传统纹样、色彩和故事与现代设计结合、受年轻人追捧的本土潮流风格，常见于服饰和美妆联名。
def.en: A homegrown fashion wave that blends traditional patterns, colors and stories with modern design and wins over young consumers, especially in apparel and cosmetics.

usage.zh: 这件国潮卫衣把云纹印在袖口上。
usage.en: This China-chic hoodie prints cloud patterns along the cuffs.

def.zh: 以汉民族传统服饰形制为基础复刻改良的现代服装，常出现在节日出游和国风活动，面料和版型分很多流派。
def.en: Modern clothing reproduced and adapted from traditional Han Chinese dress, worn at festivals, outings and Chinese-style cultural events, and sold in many regional styles.

usage.zh: 她穿着汉服去赏花，一路上被要求合影。
usage.en: She went flower viewing in hanfu and was asked for photos all along the way.

def.zh: 被列入保护名录的传统技艺、戏曲、民俗等活态文化遗产，近年常靠短视频重新走红，也吸引年轻人拜师。
def.en: Living heritage such as traditional crafts, opera and folk customs listed for protection, often finding new fame through short videos.

usage.zh: 竹编非遗传承人开直播，订单排到了明年。
usage.en: The bamboo-weaving heritage inheritor went live and orders are booked into next year.

def.zh: 用实景布景、光影和剧情把观众整个包进去，让人暂时忘掉现实的艺术体验形式，多用于戏剧和展览。
def.en: An art format that wraps the audience inside physical sets, lighting and story so completely that reality slips away for a while.

usage.zh: 这场沉浸式戏剧没有固定座位，观众跟着演员跑。
usage.en: The immersive play had no fixed seats and the audience followed the actors around.

def.zh: 玩家各自扮演一个角色，靠搜证、盘问和讨论共同还原一桩凶案的线下社交游戏，一局常要四五个小时。
def.en: An offline social game where each player acts a role and, through clue hunting, questioning and discussion, the group reconstructs a murder.

usage.zh: 周末六个人开了一局剧本杀，玩了五个小时。
usage.en: Six of us ran a script murder game at the weekend and played for five hours.

def.zh: 集中展示动漫作品、售卖周边并举办同好活动的线下展会，很多人会精心角色扮演到场，排队几小时只为买限定。
def.en: An offline convention that showcases anime works, sells merchandise and hosts fan events, with many attendees arriving in elaborate cosplay.

usage.zh: 今年漫展摊位比去年多了一倍。
usage.en: This year's comic convention had twice as many booths as last year.

def.zh: 爱好者以原作的人物或世界观为基础，自行创作的漫画、小说、音乐等非官方作品，在圈内以同人志形式流传。
def.en: Unofficial comics, fiction, music or other works that fans create on top of an existing story's characters or world, without the rights holder's involvement.

usage.zh: 她写的同人小说比原作还火。
usage.en: The fan fiction she writes is more popular than the original novel.

def.zh: 吃饭时用来佐餐的短视频、剧集或播客，内容不太重要，关键是让一个人吃饭不无聊、不显得孤单。
def.en: The short videos, series or podcasts people play while eating alone, chosen less for quality than for making a solo meal less dull.

usage.zh: 没有电子榨菜，这顿饭吃得特别漫长。
usage.en: Without my digital side dish, the meal felt endless.

def.zh: 让人感到被理解、被安慰和被陪伴的体验，如今也被拿来衡量一段关系或一次消费值不值得。
def.en: The experience of feeling understood, comforted and accompanied, now also used to judge whether a relationship or service is worth it.

usage.zh: 这家店卖的不是咖啡，是情绪价值。
usage.en: This shop sells not coffee but emotional value.

def.zh: 特意避开热门城市和旺季，去人少、物价低的小城慢慢待着的出行方式，主打不排队和性价比。
def.en: A travel style that deliberately avoids famous cities and peak season, heading instead to quiet, cheap small towns to slow down.

usage.zh: 国庆他反向旅游，去了个没人听过的小县城。
usage.en: For the holiday he did reverse travel and went to a tiny county nobody has heard of.

def.zh: 为吃饭、健身、看展等某件具体的事临时结伴的人，关系轻，不需要深交，散了也不用刻意维持。
def.en: A temporary companion for one specific activity such as eating, working out or seeing a show, with a light bond that needs no deep friendship.

usage.zh: 她在网上找了个饭搭子，一周拼了三次火锅。
usage.en: She found a meal partner online and they shared hotpot three times in one week.

def.zh: 整个人看起来不赶时间、不焦虑输赢的从容状态，被很多人当成理想的生活气质，也常被夸成高级感。
def.en: A relaxed state of not rushing and not being anxious about winning, which many people now treat as the ideal way to be.

usage.zh: 飞机延误三小时，她还坐在那儿看书，满是松弛感。
usage.en: With the flight delayed three hours, she just sat reading with total chill.

def.zh: 不设明确目的、沿着街道慢慢走，随性发现城市角落和店铺的休闲散步方式，常配一杯咖啡走一下午。
def.en: A casual way of wandering city streets with no fixed goal, discovering corners and small shops at an easy pace.

usage.zh: 周末没什么安排，就去老城区citywalk。
usage.en: With no plans for the weekend, we went on a citywalk through the old town.

def.zh: 一边熬夜一边靠保健品、按摩仪和手机提醒自我安慰的年轻人养生方式，朋克又带着心虚。
def.en: A young people's health routine that mixes late nights with supplements, massage devices and phone reminders to feel healthy anyway.

usage.zh: 凌晨两点吃护肝片，这就是赛博养生。
usage.en: Taking liver pills at two in the morning is cyber wellness in action.

def.zh: 靠网络远程工作、每隔一段时间就换个城市生活旅居，不受固定办公室约束的人，常聚集在低价宜居的小城。
def.en: People who work remotely over the internet and move to a different city every so often, free from a fixed office.

usage.zh: 他在大理做数字游民，上午开会下午爬山。
usage.en: He lives as a digital nomad in Dali, taking calls in the morning and hiking in the afternoon.

def.zh: 在本职工作之外，利用业余时间经营的第二个收入来源，常见的有自媒体、网店和接单跑腿。
def.en: A second income stream run in spare time outside a main job, commonly through content accounts or online shops, often used to test an idea before quitting.

usage.zh: 白天上班，晚上做副业卖手作。
usage.en: He works by day and runs a side hustle selling handmade goods at night.

def.zh: 带上帐篷和装备到郊外或营地过夜，用一顿烧烤和一夜星空换掉城市的周末，装备越买越多。
def.en: Heading to the countryside or a campsite with a tent and gear to spend the night, trading the city weekend for a barbecue and a sky full of stars.

usage.zh: 这家人每个周末都去露营，后备箱塞满了装备。
usage.en: The family camps every weekend, the trunk packed with gear.

def.zh: 在草坪上多人传接飞盘、规则简单易上手的户外运动，社交属性比竞技性更强，也被当成认识新朋友的场合。
def.en: An easy-to-learn outdoor game where a group passes a disc across a lawn, valued more for the social side than for competition.

usage.zh: 公司的飞盘局每周三晚上在草坪上。
usage.en: The company frisbee game is on the lawn every Wednesday evening.

def.zh: 长期上班留下的疲惫、麻木和公式化气质，同事一眼就能从状态里认出来，休假也散不掉。
def.en: The weary, numb and scripted air that long office hours leave on a person, recognizable to colleagues at a glance.

usage.zh: 假期回来才三天，班味又上来了。
usage.en: Only three days back from holiday and the work fatigue vibe returned.

def.zh: 有清晰的自我评价标准，不被外界评价和突发状况轻易带偏的心理状态，遇事先稳住再处理。
def.en: A mental state with a clear inner yardstick, where outside opinions and sudden events cannot easily knock you off course.

usage.zh: 被骂了一整轮，她还是很平静，内核稳定得厉害。
usage.en: She took a full round of criticism calmly, her inner stability impressive.

def.zh: 主动扔掉不必要的东西、减少占有，让房间和心态都清爽起来的整理理念，处理旧物时也顺带放下执念。
def.en: A tidying philosophy of actively discarding what is not needed and owning less, so both the room and the mind feel lighter.

usage.zh: 她断舍离了一整个衣柜，心情都变好了。
usage.en: She decluttered her entire wardrobe and her mood improved with it.

def.zh: 外形和关节结构模仿人类、能在为人设计的环境里走动和操作工具的双足机器人，常被拿来补工厂的缺工。
def.en: A two-legged robot whose shape and joints imitate a person, letting it walk and handle tools in spaces built for humans.

usage.zh: 工厂里试用人形机器人搬箱子，走路还有点笨。
usage.en: The factory is trialing humanoid robots to move boxes, though they still walk a bit clumsily.

def.zh: 把大脑神经信号直接翻译成设备指令、让意念控制外设的技术通道，已用于康复训练和实验室研究。
def.en: A technical channel that translates brain signals directly into device commands so thought can control equipment, already used in rehab and lab trials.

usage.zh: 脑机接口让瘫痪患者用意念重新打出了字。
usage.en: The brain-computer interface let a paralyzed patient type again by thought.

def.zh: 车辆靠摄像头和雷达感知路况、由算法自主完成转向、加速与刹车的驾驶能力，目前仍要求人随时接管。
def.en: A vehicle's ability to sense the road with cameras and radar and handle steering, acceleration and braking through algorithms alone.

usage.zh: 这段高速他全程开自动驾驶，手都没怎么碰方向盘。
usage.en: On the highway he stayed on autonomous driving the whole way, barely touching the wheel.

def.zh: 利用量子的叠加和纠缠并行处理信息，在密码破解和药物模拟等特定问题上远超经典计算机的路线。
def.en: A computing route that uses quantum superposition and entanglement to process information in parallel, far outpacing classical machines on problems like cryptography and drug simulation.

usage.zh: 这家实验室的量子计算原型机又刷新了纪录。
usage.en: The lab's quantum computing prototype set another record.

def.zh: 用固态电解质替代易燃液态电解液的电池，能量密度更高、更耐高温也更安全，被视作电动车的下一站。
def.en: A battery that replaces flammable liquid electrolyte with a solid one, packing more energy per kilogram and holding up better under heat.

usage.zh: 搭载固态电池的车，续航标称破了一千公里。
usage.en: The car with a solid-state battery claims over a thousand kilometers of range.

def.zh: 以无人机和飞行器在千米以下空域做载人、送货和巡检带动的产业群，外卖和急救都开始用上。
def.en: The industry cluster around drones and aircraft flying below one kilometer, carrying people, delivering goods and inspecting facilities, from food delivery to emergency response.

usage.zh: 政策一放开，低空经济成了地方招商的热词。
usage.en: Once rules loosened, the low-altitude economy became a favorite for local investment pitches.

def.zh: 由民营企业参与火箭发射、卫星制造和太空服务的产业，靠可回收和批量生产压低成本，发射报价年年降。
def.en: The industry where private companies build rockets, satellites and space services, cutting cost through reusability and mass production, with launch prices falling every year.

usage.zh: 这家商业航天公司今年完成了第五次发射。
usage.en: The commercial space company completed its fifth launch this year.

def.zh: 用成千上万颗低轨卫星组成星座，为地面基站覆盖不到的海上、山区和灾区提供宽带上网。
def.en: A constellation of thousands of low-orbit satellites providing broadband to oceans, mountains and disaster zones that ground towers cannot cover.

usage.zh: 靠卫星互联网，救援队在深山里也能发消息。
usage.en: Thanks to satellite internet, the rescue team could send messages deep in the mountains.

def.zh: 5G的增强版本，上传下载更快、时延更低，也是通信行业向6G过渡的中间阶段，基站只需软件升级。
def.en: An enhanced version of 5G with faster speeds and lower latency, positioned as the stepping stone between 5G and 6G.

usage.zh: 换了5G-A套餐，下载电影只要十几秒。
usage.en: On a 5G-A plan, downloading a movie takes about ten seconds.

def.zh: 模仿太阳内部反应、让轻原子核在受控条件下持续释放能量的发电路线，被视为终极清洁能源。
def.en: A power route that mimics the sun, fusing light nuclei under control to release energy continuously, often called the ultimate clean energy source.

usage.zh: 可控核聚变一旦商用，电价可能被彻底改写。
usage.en: If controlled fusion goes commercial, electricity prices could be rewritten entirely.

def.zh: 把电路图案精确投影到硅片上的核心芯片制造设备，它的精度直接决定芯片能做到多小、多省电。
def.en: The core chip-making machine that projects circuit patterns precisely onto silicon wafers, its precision deciding how small a chip can be.

usage.zh: 没有高端光刻机，先进制程就卡在这一步。
usage.en: Without advanced lithography machines, the cutting-edge process node stalls right here.

def.zh: 手机里那块指甲盖大小、内部集成数十亿晶体管的半导体器件，是计算和存储的基础元件。
def.en: The fingernail-sized semiconductor device in a phone that packs billions of transistors, the basic building block for computing and storage.

usage.zh: 这台手机换了一颗国产芯片。
usage.en: This phone runs on a domestically made chip.

def.zh: 把数据处理放在离设备很近的本地节点上完成，减少往返云端的延迟和带宽消耗，适合工厂和路口。
def.en: Processing data at local nodes close to the devices instead of round-tripping to the cloud, cutting latency and bandwidth use.

usage.zh: 工厂用边缘计算做质检，反应比传回云端快得多。
usage.en: The factory uses edge computing for quality checks, far faster than sending data to the cloud.
